reviews.text: Kind, professional care
I can only think of positive opinions. The expertise of the female doctors is top-notch - and even the cat Szofi tolerated the treatments very well.

Very thorough examination and informative doctor. It was my first time here with my cat, after a long search we came to Boxi vet on the recommendation of a friend. From now on I can only recommend it with a good heart!
They are kind, they helped immediately and professionally, and their prices are fair. We are extremely satisfied with them.
The best clinic!

Today, Dr. Kata Baranyi saw us without an appointment. We received very professional, kind and empathetic care. My cat has a very difficult nature, but they were patient and persistent with her throughout. We are grateful for the help she and her assistant gave us!

It's rare to meet such a kind and helpful team. The assistants were very patient and helpful even on the phone. The doctor is thorough, kind, explains everything clearly, and it was especially nice that she didn't recommend unnecessary tests or treatments. It's a good feeling to find a clinic where the goal is not to make the owner pay as much as possible, but where they really have the animal's interests in mind. I recommend it wholeheartedly!

I dropped in with the dog at closing time but unfortunately there was no situation. They were nice because they welcomed me and looked at me.
Thank you very much again
We always receive great care. The doctors are professional, kind, and attentive.

We have been going to Boxi for years, with several dogs and cats. Our animals always receive kind, correct and professionally high-quality care, they communicate well with us and people, they inform us about everything verbally and we also receive correct written documentation.
The professional dedication, knowledge, kindness and thoroughness of Dr. Orsolya Szepes and her team provide an experience for owners and their pets alike! 😊 …

True professionalism and heart-and-soul medicine. My puppy was in the best possible hands. We received detailed information about the necessary surgery, and during the recovery, Dr. Orsolya Szepes answered all my questions quickly and helpfully. I recommend the clinic wholeheartedly!
Because Orsi is a conscientious and good veterinarian!
It's a little confusing that in the case of a returning patient, three different doctors said different things in three different weeks, even though everyone was very nice!
We have been going to Orsi for years. He is the best vet in the area. He is kind, caring, thorough and works at absolutely fair prices. I wouldn't trust my dog ​​to anyone else.

I took my 10 month old puppy to be neutered and they managed to overdose him so much that he didn't wake up again. They gave me a towel, I had to bring him in it, I haven't heard from them since.
Incompetent, soulless place.
(the lady I rescued him from recommended it, now she doesn't recommend it to anyone)

We love BoxiVet. Everyone is super nice, flexible and you can tell they love animals. In addition to the standard check-ups, we also brought our elderly pug for dental surgery, which they took great care of. 🙏🙏 thank you for your care! …
They are always very kind, they examine my cat thoroughly, answer all my questions and give me advice. My cat is completely calm in the hands of both the assistants and the doctors :)
Super friendly, competent, well equipped

Very nice, helpful team. The place is small but everything fits in and it is well designed.
Thanks for the spay/neuter! Bro
Super!!!!

It's a horrible place, unfortunately. We've been there 3 times (and the last time). The last time they started by asking if my dog ​​was friendly (I have a Staffie). So they didn't even recognize my dog ​​or us.. I left anyway. We went to them with a bleeding earlobe and an inflamed ear, for which we were given a simple ear cleaning drop. Since he's itching, he shakes and scratches his ear, which starts the bleeding at the end of his ear again. I asked several times if there was anything we could do about it because the dog's head is full of blood... I quote "it won't heal on its own"... Well, okay... he healed for 2 weeks, then the inflammation in his ear developed again and everything started all over again. In other words, it continued because the problem wasn't really solved, his ear was only cleaned... We were there for 2 days because my dog's nail also broke. We were there for 5 minutes and they only cut off that tiny part for 12,000 kuna. Disgusting. They didn't even look at his ears, the female doctor spoke to us with a wooden face. Today I took him to another nearby vet who is interested in his profession, not in money, and he looked at my dog ​​pitifully. How can they be like that, that I get a simple cleanser for an inflamed ear. And I don't know how to do that, I'm not a doctor either. The doctor gave me drops to reduce inflammation and cream for his earlobe so that it would heal. He looked at me like a big guy, but they didn't do anything with that... Drops, cream, examination were all the same price as a nail clip here in this place that can't be called a veterinary clinic. Don't go there, I don't recommend it to anyone!!!!

Excellent veterinary clinic. Professional, compassionate, they genuinely care and always put the animal first. After many years with Boxi Veterinary, I can confidently say my cat couldn’t be in better hands.
They are extremely professional!
I can only write the best about the doctors and their assistance working in the clinic. I thank them for my friend Brusz's recovery!

Unfortunately, I had a very bad experience with this clinic. The service was inadequate, the examination was incomplete, and the attitude was disappointing. I didn't get a bill, they charged random costs, and the cat I brought in wasn't even examined 😢 when I reported the problem, they didn't help, they just ignored me.
Overall, I felt that the best interests of the animal or professional thoroughness were not the first priority, but rather that they wanted to charge as much as possible. I'm sorry, but I don't recommend it to anyone - it's better to avoid such places.

We have been going to them with our dog and cat for years.
They are professional and very helpful.
Our little pets are in safe hands here.

Everyone was very nice, I went there when my puppy had watery diarrhea, they were helpful in everything, they didn't sedate my dog ​​as it usually happens in many places.
I have never had such a good experience, we will go here again next time if necessary, by the way, the price I paid was human.
Super, I can only recommend it.

I adopted Floki almost four years ago, and from the very first minute we have been going to Dr. Orsolya Szepes and the Boxi Clinic team. Although we have tried other clinics, somehow our hearts have always been drawn back to this one. The doctor and the assistants are incredibly kind, patient and dedicated. Floki also feels the love: he is never afraid, and in fact he really likes coming here. We have had to go back often lately, but the doctor always comes to us with patience, expertise and a genuine desire to help. It is very important to me that the financial aspect is not what counts here, but the health of the animal and the owner's peace of mind. I am grateful that we found such a clinic. 🤎
